title: 第十七章 气随意动第十八章 民俗目
content_zh:
“噗呲！”
刀锋划过喉咙竟然给他了一种身临其境的感觉，甚至就连血液从喉咙中向外流动都清晰可见，甚至感应在身上。
活了六十年，他也是在外边拼过打过。
手里的这杆枪以前的旧时代也是显现过用处，然而面对着这百人以上的军队，见到这般场景，宋风也只是用长枪挑了数人便已经被一拥而上。
说到底，终归也是普通人。
双方都是些没有身穿甲胄的，哪有什么打个百十回合打的天崩地裂那种开局，只要一刀砍中了那基本上血就哗哗往外流。
活了这么多年，宋风枪法总归也是有那么一点点的了不得。
俗话说拳怕少壮，棍怕老郎。
年刀月棍，一辈子枪。
这枪法练了一个甲子，总归也比那些只练了几十年的年轻小伙子强，在技巧上以及精准上强的不止一点。
但就算是这样，他也只是用手中长枪挑死了几个人之后，便被人家乱刀砍死了。
没办法，主要是没那个条件。
毕竟没谁刚出江湖，就直接会面对上百个人以上的兵马围杀。
这种情况基本上没有第二个可能。
以一当百又都是普通人，没有超凡力量，这不就是堆也能堆死。
不说别的事情。
只是宋风身上的气息流动之下，他的筋骨力道甚至就连皮肉都被气息撑开，甚至比年轻力壮的时候还更加强悍。
说得上是一个加强版的巅峰存在。
可惜了，气机流动之下他力量增强了则恢复到了巅峰状态，甚至更强，但终究还是个普通人。
感受着血液在身体之中流淌出来，甚至被人不断的拿着刀劈斧砍，宋风的最后一个念头竟然是终于可以醒过来了。

没人能够经得住酷刑。
别管你是年纪大的还是年纪小的。
吹牛逼的时候吹的棒棒硬，但是让刀劈斧砍，剁上几根手指头就知道死亡是何等恐惧了。
他承认他自己确实没有看破生死。
然而就在他以为自己即将活过来的时候，面前一晃却又突然来到了那一个黑暗的环境之中，放眼望去，面前竟然又是那上百个手拿刀枪的精壮汉子。
此刻他仍然是手中拿着那杆大枪。
以一挡百？
别胡闹了，他都多大年纪了，可没有年轻的时候那般热血了。
然而他怎么想不重要，问题是对面那上百个人已经真的冲上来了，甚至拿着刀要把他砍死了。
见到这一幕。
宋风心中也没有什么别的想法了，人枪合一，追魂夺命十三枪，枪枪爆头，在有了第一次的经验之后，他杀人的时候也是多了几分狠劲。
毕竟已经在这里死过一次了。
上一次第一次出手他都能够挑死几个人，如今手持这一杆马槊大枪，他如何能下不了狠心？
有时候心态就是这么神奇，只是心态那么一转变，他手中大枪就挥舞如风，各种各样的杀伐手段也都更加圆润。
content_en:
"Pfft!"
The blade cutting across his throat actually gave him an immersive feeling. Even the blood flowing outward from his throat could be clearly seen and even felt on his body.
After living for sixty years, he also struggled outside.
The gun in his hand has also shown its use in the old times. However, facing an army of more than a hundred people and seeing such a scene, Song Feng only picked a few people with his spear and was already swarmed.
After all, they are still ordinary people.
Both sides are not wearing armor, so there is no such thing as a 100-round fight with the world shattering. As long as the sword hits, the blood will basically flow out.
After living for so many years, Song Feng's marksmanship is still a little bit amazing.
As the saying goes, the boxer is afraid of the young and the stick is afraid of the old man.
A sword and a stick for a lifetime, a gun for a lifetime.
After practicing this marksmanship for a few years, it is still better than those young guys who have only practiced it for decades. It is more than a little better in terms of technique and accuracy.
But even so, he only picked a few people to death with the spear in his hand, and then was hacked to death by others.
There is no way, mainly because we don’t have the conditions.
After all, no one will face hundreds of soldiers and horses as soon as they leave the world.
There is basically no second possibility in this situation.
If one is equivalent to a hundred and they are all ordinary people without extraordinary power, they can be piled to death even if they are piled up.
Don't say anything else.
It's just that under the flow of Song Feng's body, his muscles and bones and even his skin and flesh are stretched by the breath, even stronger than when he was young and strong.
It can be said to be an enhanced version of the peak existence.
It's a pity that as Qi flowed, his strength increased and he returned to his peak state, even stronger, but he was still an ordinary person after all.
Feeling the blood flowing out of his body, and even being hacked with knives and axes, Song Feng's last thought was that he could finally wake up.
No one can survive torture.
Don't care if you are older or younger.
When you brag, you brag very hard, but if you let it be chopped with a knife or an axe, you will know how scary death is when you chop off a few fingers.
He admitted that he did not see through life and death.
However, just when he thought he was about to come back to life, he suddenly came to that dark environment in front of him. Looking around, he saw hundreds of strong men with swords and guns in front of him.
At this moment, he still held the big gun in his hand.
One against a hundred?
Stop being ridiculous, he is no longer as passionate as he was when he was young.
However, it didn't matter what he thought. The problem was that the hundreds of people on the opposite side had really rushed up, even holding knives to chop him to death.
Saw this scene.
Song Feng didn't have any other ideas in his mind. The man and the gun were integrated into one, chasing souls and killing people with thirteen shots, and the gun shot the head. After his first experience, he became a little more ruthless when killing people.
After all, he has already died here once.
The last time he took action for the first time, he was able to kill several people. Now holding this big gun, how could he not be ruthless?
Sometimes the mentality is so magical. Just by changing his mentality, the big gun in his hand swings like the wind, and all kinds of killing methods become more sophisticated.
